# RecurSaathi

> RecurSaathi is a payment-recovery tool for Indian subscription businesses. It detects failed card and UPI AutoPay payments, retries inside RBI-allowed windows, sends WhatsApp and email nudges with one-tap UPI payment links, and tracks overdue invoices and dormant customers. Plans start at ₹999/month with a 14-day free trial. RecurSaathi never holds customer money: payments settle directly into the business's own Razorpay account or UPI ID.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://recursathii.onrender.com/): product overview, pricing, FAQ
- [UPI AutoPay failed payment recovery](https://recursathii.onrender.com/upi-autopay-recovery): why mandates fail and the right recovery move for each reason
- [Guide: recover failed subscription payments in India](https://recursathii.onrender.com/guide): RBI retry windows, dunning sequence, manual UPI backup
- [Free failed payment loss calculator](https://recursathii.onrender.com/failed-payment-calculator): estimate monthly revenue lost to failed card and UPI AutoPay payments; runs in the browser, nothing stored

## Facts
- Built for: edtech and coaching, fitness studios, D2C subscriptions, agencies
- Works without a gateway (manual UPI QR mode); Razorpay AutoPay retries when connected
- RBI-compliant retries: 24-hour, 72-hour and day-7 windows, routed by decline code, never blind-retried on invalid cards
- Pricing (excl. 18% GST): Starter ₹999, Growth ₹4,999, Enterprise ₹5,999 per month; annual ₹9,990 / ₹49,990 / ₹59,990
- Enterprise adds: multi-branch management (up to 5 branches), custom automation rules, REST API with keys, custom PDF reports, manager permissions, predictive revenue leak and daily insights (rule-based, on the business's own records)
- Contact: recursathi@gmail.com
